# Mobile UI/UX

## Procedure

1. Map the screen and interaction to a BRD user story and current phase.
2. Reuse a small design system for type, spacing, color, controls, focus, and feedback.
3. Design loading, empty, offline, permission-denied, quota, and recoverable-error states before the happy path.
4. Make touch targets, labels, contrast, dynamic text, screen-reader semantics, and motion respectful.
5. Keep voice controls unambiguous: recording, processing, speaking, cancel, and retry must be visible.
6. Validate on narrow Android screens and document intentional platform differences.
